mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, N.NOTICE_TYPE_CD AS noticeTypeCd, N.TITLE AS title, N.BODY AS body, N.WRITER_NAME AS writerName, TRIM(N.PIN_YN) AS pinYn, TRIM(N.VISIBLE_YN) AS visibleYn, N.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, N.REG_DATE AS regDate, N.MOD_DATE AS modDate FROM TB_NOTICE N ORDER BY TRIM(N.PIN_YN) DESC, N.REG_DATE DESC, N.NOTICE_ID DESC

SELECT N.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, N.NOTICE_TYPE_CD AS noticeTypeCd, N.TITLE AS title, N.BODY AS body, N.WRITER_NAME AS writerName, TRIM(N.PIN_YN) AS pinYn, TRIM(N.VISIBLE_YN) AS visibleYn, N.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, N.REG_DATE AS regDate, N.MOD_DATE AS modDate FROM TB_NOTICE N WHERE N.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
